    • createPlayers

      Creates the list of players by prompting for type, name, and birth date for each.

      Returns:

    • reorderByYoungest

      public static List<Player> reorderByYoungest(List<Player> players, List<LocalDate> birthDates)
      Reorders the player list so that the youngest player is first, preserving the original clockwise seating order. For example, if players are [A, B, C, D] and C is youngest, the result is [C, D, A, B].
      Parameters:
      players - the original list of players
      birthDates - a parallel list of birth dates for each player
      Returns:
      a new list starting from the youngest player in clockwise order

      Returns:

      Throws:
